verdict.rationale: Sketch ships a built-in, local-only MCP server that AI clients like Claude can connect to. Sketch's AI page says you can take any frame and build it out in code with 1:1 visual fidelity, so the core agent-pulls-frame-to-implement flow is documented. Missing for 10: documentation that the MCP server exposes variables/tokens, screenshots, and component (Symbol) mappings to the agent; a documented tool/API reference; independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my coding agent can pull real design context — frames, variables, screenshots, component mappings — through an MCP server or API to implement the design

citations.quote: Sketch includes a built-in MCP Server, a lightweight local-only web server that lets AI clients like ChatGPT or Claude interact directly with Sketch.
Take any frame in Sketch and build it out in code with 1:1 visual fidelity.
Connect any MCP-compatible AI client you like to Sketch.
